column3: NASB supplies “including”; “as one man” renders “like one man.”
NASB puts the first sentence in parentheses and supplies “us.”
“the men of Gibeah” renders “the citizens of Gibeah”; “ravished” renders “abused,” and NASB supplies “instead.”
“a lewd and disgraceful act” renders “wickedness and disgraceful folly.”
NASB supplies “we will go up”; the Hebrew reads only “against it by lot.”
“the entire tribe” renders the Hebrew plural “all the tribes.”
“left-handed” renders “impeded in his right hand”; NASB supplies “were.”
“the men of Israel” renders the collective “the man of Israel” (also in later verses).
NASB opens a parenthesis here that runs into verse 28.
NASB supplies “to minister” and closes its parenthesis; “them” renders the Hebrew singular “him.”
“as at other times” renders “as time upon time.”
